title: Mosey Bank page published
description: Sent by the site (src/lib/mark/triggers.ts) when a person publishes a page that has no categories, meta title or meta description.

contentKey.description: The page's content key, 32 hex characters; pass it to the mosey_* tools as page and to cms_update_content_item as the content key.

version.description: Version number of the published version.

locale.description: Locale that was published, e.g. en or nl.

docId.description: The Graph document id the event carried: {guid}_{locale}_Published.
